Peek at entry point and packages

data.value: It's a small Node.js demo monorepo (used as the clone target for [tangle.tools](https://tangle.tools) examples) whose entry point wires together an HTTP API server, a background worker queue, and a CLI with flag parsing, backed by shared utilities across `packages/{api,cli,shared,web,worker}`. It ships a `node --test` suite plus a benchmark script, with three tests (`cli-flag`, `null-guard`, `timezone`) intentionally failing for demonstration purposes.
